facts.countryScope: Only source records tagged en:algeria. Does not prove manufacturing origin or present Oran inventory.

priceResearch.scope: Third-party public retail references only. Not imported into offers, pricing or stock.

identityQuality: Checksum-valid source identifiers, local photo decoding/hashes, exact source-revision links, targeted visual review and 49 explicit brand-label transcriptions. Country tags are community supplied. No claim of manufacturer certification, exhaustive label review or current Oran inventory.

brandReview.method: Transcribe visible brand text only when original OFF brand is empty; preserve sourceBrand:null, exact image revision and image hash.

visualReview.overlap: These stage samples overlap; counts are not an exhaustive review of all2500labels.

normalization.categories: Exact taxonomy tags plus word-boundary name matching; no beverage parent-tag substring matching.
normalization.quantities: Suppress missing, price-like, implausible mg and unrecognizable display quantities; retain raw sourceQuantity.
normalization.titleRetailPrices: Removed from display names only; sourceName preserved.
